content.text: Register doesn't pass a provider, so the default in `UsersService.create` applies.

candidates.explanation: When no provider is supplied, the provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google instead of AuthProvidersEnum.email. The email register flow (AuthService.register) calls usersService.create without a provider, so the new user is stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees provider !== 'email' and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.
Register creates the user without setting provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email, so it relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Change the default provider in UsersService.create to AuthProvidersEnum.email (`createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email`). Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
